evidence: The module docstring says transferred microscopy tutorial data contained no saved classifier training curves.
_write_curve constructs accuracy-derived neg_accuracy, pos_accuracy and prauc plus a sinusoidal threshold; these are generated numbers, not model evaluations.
main constructs 20-epoch baseline and 25-epoch tuned trajectories with NumPy linspace/exp and manually inserted late validation declines.
_cv_run constructs three 18-epoch folds using fixed offsets -0.018, 0.006 and 0.022; no models are fitted.
Settings including model names, learning rates, classes, worker counts and device=cuda are fabricated example configuration, not evidence of training or hardware use.
The incomplete .pth is a 40-byte text placeholder, not a loadable trained checkpoint.

capture_recipe.evidence: SOURCE points only to ROOT/synthetic/training_runs. The recipe uses the real Scan and Overlay selected consumers on those fixtures, programmatically selects runs/metrics/fold modes and calls identify_series; it performs no training and references no genuine multi-epoch run. original_capture_provenance.search_limit: This finding applies only to the original lesson's exact preparation/capture recipes and their manifests, not to every file on the machine.

available_real_training_output.classification: Actual completed private Classify training output from the downloaded example crop dataset; not a synthetic log fixture and not scientifically accepted held-out validation
available_real_training_output.metric_interpretation: prauc is macro average precision in this two-output multiclass consumer. Both logs also record per-class accuracies/supports and num_classes; train additionally records lr and train_time. Empty neg_accuracy, pos_accuracy and optimal_threshold columns are not offered as usable metrics. The duplicate Accuracy column is normalized away; list-valued columns are not numeric curves.
available_real_training_output.scientific_limit: The prior independent database-identity audit found actual wells plate1/r12/c1, plate1/r12/c2 and plate1/r5/c2 in both train and test, despite the software leakage report saying PASS. These logs cannot establish independent well-held-out performance.

sibling_incomplete_folder.reason: _looks_like_run requires a progress CSV, a .pth file, a *_per_fold.csv file, or a fold directory holding curves. Settings plus an audit alone do not qualify. Do not create placeholder files to manufacture a second run.

narration_corrections.decision: Keep comparison purpose as a capability; do not imply this single genuine run demonstrates several fits.
Remove registry input. GUI accepts a folder. Original synthetic capture provenance must not be presented as genuine trained-model evidence.
Keep discovery, available metrics and warnings as capabilities. Scan does not validate scientific comparability; no naturally discoverable second/incomplete private run is available here.
Remove smoothing and selectable settings fields. Actual controls are Metric, Folds and Overlay selected; the settings diff is automatic.
Do not claim convergence, stability or overfitting has been demonstrated from one recorded epoch.
Say best/last recorded epoch, not separately evaluated best/final checkpoint. The best point is selected on the same curve and can be optimistic; neither point proves generalization.
Fold mean plus/minus sample SD is a supported capability, not an observed result of this non-fold run.
Keep settings/provenance review as part of a wider evaluation; do not claim reproducibility or independent held-out performance from these inputs.
